main.description: A question ("koe" / 声) sent to a Mado box. Written to the box OWNER's repo, so the sender's repo holds no trace. The body is public; the sender's identity is encrypted and readable only by the owner.

encryptedFrom.description: Base64-encoded ECIES ciphertext of the sender's DID, encrypted with the box's publicKeyHex. A fresh ephemeral key per encryption makes ciphertexts unlinkable. Decryptable only by the box owner.

body.description: Plaintext question text. Public on the PDS ("semi-anonymous": content is open, sender is not).

box.description: AT-URI of the blue.mado.box this question targets.
